notes.title: 4 Hour Closed Playtest - New Content Feedback
notes.content:
July 11th Closed Playtest #5 Patch Notes

This playtest will run for 4 hours and we hope you can make it. If you don't have a key from a prior closed playtest, please request access through the Steam page prior to the test period.

Join other players in our Discord.

Our goal for this session is to get feedback on the new content we’ve added, and test some new backend systems in development against higher concurrent player counts.

For this playtest:

 All spells are unlocked, and class mastery is disabled
 Level Cap reduced from 5 > 3
 Merchant is set to level 3 by default
 Ruined Castle (Night) Map disabled

We want all players to have access to and experiment with all content that is available. Future playtests will reintroduce map selection and unlockable progression.

Ping System 🗺️
We now have a ping system players can use in matches to communicate with teammates. Pings are on a radial menu bound to the middle mouse button, and can be re-bound in the settings menu.

New Weapons
🔨 Hammer: A heavy crushing weapon that strikes a circular AoE

 Charges: 2
 Recharge Time: 2.15

📖 Spellbook: A Magical tome that conjures a circle of damaging energy.

 Charges: 4
 Recharge Time: 1.6

🧙 Elemental Staff & Spellbook

 Staff and Spellbook both can roll various element tags (Fire), (Shadow), Etc. These attacks scale off of your magic and (Tag) stats.

New Class: Felsworn
Brimming with power bought through 💀 dark pacts with darker forces, Felsworn command the powers of death and destruction, and leave only devastation in their wake.

Tags: Light Armor, Medium Armor, Fire, Shadow, Spellbook, Staff, Sword

New Abilities:
Drain Life - In an area around you, deal damage and heal yourself for every enemy hit for a short duration.

 Tags: Shadow
 Cooldown: 14
 Duration: 4.5
 Tick Rate: 0.5
 Damage: 4 + 36% Magic/Shadow
 Heal: 3 + 18% Magic/Shadow

☠️ Death’s Caress - Throws a piercing projectile that moves in a straight line and then returns, dealing damage and healing you for every enemy hit.

 Tags: Shadow
 Cooldown: 11
 Damage: 11 + 87% Magic/Shadow
 Heal: 5 + 44% Magic/Shadow

Raise Dead - Deal damage and apply a slight slow in a target area, then summon a skeleton that attacks nearby enemies. 

 Tags: Shadow, Felsworn Only
 Cooldown: 11
 Initial Damage: 8 + 64% Magic/Shadow
 Skeleton Damage: 8 + 64% Magic/Shadow

Flame Skeleton- Summon a Flame Skeleton that throws fireballs at nearby enemies. 


 Tags: Shadow, Fire, Felsworn Only
 Cooldown: 14
 Skeleton Damage: 8 + 65% Magic/Fire/Shadow

🔥 Fireball - Throws a fireball in a straight line that explodes for damage on impact

 Tags - Fire
 Cooldown: 11
 Damage: 27 + 214% Magic/Fire

Global Changes
Pregame lobby: Lobby timer is now dynamic to support more consistent match population.

 Timer now lasts 3 minutes
 Once 6 or more players are in a lobby, the timer is reduced to 60 seconds (if it is not already below 60 seconds when the 6th player enters the lobby.)

Full lobbies are way more fun. This new system creates more opportunities for full games, and still provides shorter queue times when lobbies populate quickly.

Weapon Changes
🏹 Bow

 Recharge rate increased (faster): 2.1s -> 1.6s
 Damage lowered to maintain similar DPS

⚔️ Sword

 Weapon max Charges: 3 -> 4
 Recharge time increased: 2.1 -> 1.65
 Damage lowered to maintain similar DPS

✳️ Spear

 Weapon Max Charges: 2 -> 4
 Recharge rate increased: 2.3 -> 1.65
 Startup time: 0.7 -> 0.5
 Damage lowered to maintain similar DPS

One of our most common pieces of feedback was that waiting for weapon Charges to replenish felt too slow. Increasing the Charge count and recharge rate makes weapons more active, while decreasing the damage per-hit maintains overall game balance.

Ability Changes
Charge

 Cooldown: 8 -> 12
 Slow: 80% for 2 seconds -> 80% for 1 second
 Damage: 21 + 165% Phys -> 10 + 83% phys

We underestimated the value of the utility charge brings to the table. The slow and damage values still make for a useful ability, and the increased cooldown reflects its overall strength.

Lunging Strike

 Damage: 21 + 165% Phys/Sword/Spear -> 14 + 113% Phys/Sword/Spear


Like Charge, the mobility of this ability is very strong. Rather than reduce its function as a movement tool, we rebalanced its damage to better reflect the value of movement.

Rain of Arrows

 Foreshadow time: 0.9s -> 0.25s
 Damage: 5 + 38% Phys/Bow -> 5 + 41% Phys/Bow

Making this ability much easier to hit should allow it to be a more consistent peel option in PvP.

Blink

 Damage now occurs twice: once at original location, and again at the target location after arrival.
 Added: Slow 30% for 1 sec to damaged entities
 Damage: 12 + 99% Magic/Arcane -> 8 + 60% Magic/Arcane

Blink has had more versatility added so that it is stronger as an escape option or a decent damage option in different situations. It now does slightly more damage when used at point-blank range, but deals less damage in all other circumstances.

Unstable Echoes

 Unstable Echoes no longer scales with Physical Damage
 

Unstable Echoes rose to the top of the Meta in the last playtest. By scaling with both magical and physical damage, it made full use of all the player’s stats at all times, while most other abilities only make use of physical or magical.

This change should result in a damage decrease for rangers, and will push a decision to make use of Magic and Arcane stats to get full value out of Unstable Echoes, and give up other stats as a tradeoff.
